objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with progressive pain and blurry vision in one eye.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello—what brings you in today? Patient: For the past day I’ve had increasing pain and blurry vision in my right eye, and it’s been hard to open it because it hurts. My left eye feels normal. I wear contact lenses regularly, and this started suddenly without any change in my usual routine.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin excoriations—like areas where the skin is scratched, rubbed raw, or has small open spots—anywhere on your body? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any skin scratches, rubbed-raw areas, or open spots anywhere on my body.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you have pauses in breathing during sleep (for example, someone tells you, or you wake up gasping)?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t been told that I stop breathing or have pauses during sleep, and I don’t wake up gasping.

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury or fall, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, swelling, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I didn’t have any fall or injury, so I haven’t noticed severe pain, swelling, deformity, or trouble using any injured area.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (for example, a red patch or skin that feels hot compared with the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist. I’ve only had the pain and blurry vision in my right eye for the past day.
